# BlackRock Surface Co.

> Epoxy flooring contractor in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Installs flake, metallic and quartz broadcast epoxy floor systems for residential garages, basements and commercial spaces. Every job starts with diamond grinding and crack repair. Free on-site quotes. Works year-round, including winter (in heated spaces).

- Phone (call or text): 403-866-2915
- Email: blackrocksurfaces@gmail.com
- Service area: Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane and Okotoks, Alberta
- Google Business Profile: Blackrock Surface Co. (customer reviews on Google Maps)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blackrocksurfaces/

## Floor systems
- [Flake epoxy](https://blackrocksurfaces-ai.github.io/blackrock-website/flake.html): textured, hides dirt; for garages, basements, workshops and mudrooms
- [Metallic epoxy](https://blackrocksurfaces-ai.github.io/blackrock-website/metallic.html): marble-like, high-gloss custom finish; for basements, showrooms and feature garages
- [Quartz broadcast](https://blackrocksurfaces-ai.github.io/blackrock-website/quartz.html): slip-resistant, commercial-grade; for shops, kitchens and high-traffic areas
